articles.title: A behind the scenes force may amplify bitcoin and ether price volatility
articles.snippet: Both bitcoin and ether are trading in price ranges where market makers and dealers may add to market volatility.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
articles.snippet: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

articles.title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
articles.snippet: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.
